_about: Hand-check of the mechanically seeded labelled pairs (assistant_axis/gapgen/labels.py), M2 task 12, 2026-10-01, by the M2 agent (Opus) reading every non-antonym, non-random row against its decision text and both texts. keep_only: for each external member, the neighbours kept (relation/uncertain overrides) and why the other mechanically named stems were dropped. add: pairs from plan 11 section 6 not found mechanically. exclude: single rows dropped. Edit here and rerun calibrate_metric.py --rebuild-labels; labelled_pairs.json is derived.
